stories.title: Middle East War Escalates: Tanker Hit in Strait of Hormuz as Qatar Leads Diplomatic Push
stories.reason: A fresh tanker strike came even as Qatar's PM visited Tehran to revive talks, and the UAE says 15 of its vessels have now been hit since the war began.

stories.title: Broadcom seeks more than $60bn in debt to fund AI chips for Anthropic
stories.reason: The financing could reach $100 billion total, illustrating the scale of capital now required just to keep pace with AI compute demand.

stories.title: Official leading Trump's Gaza ceasefire effort criticizes Israel for its attacks
stories.reason: Public friction between Washington's own ceasefire envoy and Israel signals the fragile truce is under real strain even as Hamas has reportedly agreed to disarm.

stories.title: Will the Fed Hike Rates in September? A 25-Basis-Point Move Is Now Expected
stories.reason: Iran-linked energy shocks have flipped some forecasters from expecting a cut to expecting a hike, a sharp reversal from Powell's dovish Jackson Hole tone just days ago.

stories.title: Russian-speaking cybercriminals hacked 7 firms using SpaceX's Cursor AI
stories.reason: The Aur0ra ransomware gang repeatedly tricked Cursor's AI agent into believing real intrusions were a security test, bypassing its safety guardrails.
